title: Caretaker Tom Lewis collapses during drilling as the 1.6 GHz signal appears

tellings.quote: Our caretaker ends up being brought to his knees,
When Dragon is immediately act evacuating
tellings.difference: Calls it a cardiac episode, says Dragon evacuated him at once, and does not name the caretaker or mention the 1.6 GHz signal.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe the ranch caretaker collapsing during a recent experiment on the mesa and being taken off the ranch.

as_told.title: Caretaker evacuated after cardiac episode during experiment

plain: At Skinwalker Ranch, a property known for strange events, the caretaker Tom Lewis is said to have collapsed while the team was drilling beneath a mesa. The ranch's owner, Brandon Fugal, tells it as someone who was there, and says the caretaker was "brought to his knees". This happened as a radio signal at 1.6 gigahertz appeared during the drilling. Another witness on the same episode calls it a heart episode and says a team member called Dragon got the man out at once, without naming him or mentioning the signal. Both tell it on a 2026 episode with Jesse Michels. To them it suggests that whatever lies under the ranch can harm the people who dig toward it.
